Team / Tom — wrapping up the sales side: attaching the mutual action plan (MAP) and a security checklist we collected during the procurement review. Quick summary so CS can pick up: 

- Account: Sunnova Health (primary contact: Tom Jacobs)
- Annual committed capacity: Dedicated-2 (80k tokens/day peak) with burst to Dedicated-4 during initial pilot window
- Main integrations: SAML SSO (Azure AD), VPC peering to us-east-1, inbound IP allowlist for our envoy endpoint
- Financials: PO issued, billing contact Alice Nguyen (alice.nguyen@sunnovahealth.com) — invoice terms 30 days
- Timeline expectation: Sprint 0 (discovery + staging readiness) to start week of Sep 13, 2027; pilot go-live target Oct 11

Known risks / open items for Sprint 0:
1) Customer needs AAD metadata and test admin account for SAML setup
2) VPC peering request pending from their infra (no timeline yet)
3) Data residency verification required for two demo datasets (they prefer us-east only)

Please nominate the CS owner and tech lead. Tessa, can you own the onboarding? Vivek, can you own the infra touchpoints? We’ll need a short kickoff agenda to share with Tom.

Attachments: Sunnova-MAP-v1.3.xlsx (MAP), Sunnova-Security-Checklist.pdf (procurement evidence)

Thanks — Ben

Thanks Monica / Ben — I’ll take point. Draft plan below (I’ll turn this into the kickoff agenda doc and share before EOD Sep 9):

Sprint 0 plan (high level):
- Day 0 (Kickoff - 45m): Introductions, scope, success criteria, owner roster, scheduling
- Week 1 (Staging & SSO): Deliverables — AAD metadata ingestion, staging admin verification, initial model routing smoke test
- Week 2 (Network & Capacity): VPC peering validation, IP allowlist verification, token accounting test runs
- Week 3 (Feature baseline): Model prompts & response stability test, cost/latency checkpoint, rollout plan for pilot

Pre-kickoff checklist for Sunnova (please provide before Sep 11):
- AAD SAML metadata XML + test admin creds
- VPC peering CIDR and contact for their networking team
- PO number to match invoice (Ben indicated PO is issued)
- A short list of 2–3 sample prompt/response pairs for stability testing

Risks & mitigations:
- If VPC peering is delayed, we’ll run staging via a secure temporary tunnel and schedule a brief revalidation window for production cutover.
- If SSO metadata is incomplete, ask them for IdP SAML logs and we’ll coordinate with our SRE on mapping attributes.

Internal ask: Vivek — can you reserve the Dedicated-2 instance in staging and confirm the burst path availability? I’ll schedule the kickoff for one of Tom’s proposed dates once we confirm availability.

I will publish a kickoff agenda link and invite the customer once Ben confirms the PO and Tom confirms availability.
